en: Psalms 145

p.src: A praise psalm by David.

en: A praise psalm by David.
u.src: A praise psalm by David.

en: 145:0 This is an acrostic psalm, with every verse (including the second half of verse 13) starting with a consecutive letter of the Hebrew alphabet.

p.src: 1  I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

en: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
u.src: 1  I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

p.src: 2  Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

en: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
u.src: 2  Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

p.src: 3  Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
u.src: 3  Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

p.src: 4  One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

en: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
u.src: 4  One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

p.src: 5  I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

en: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
u.src: 5  I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

p.src: 6  Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

en: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.
u.src: 6  Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

p.src: 7  They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

en: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
u.src: 7  They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

p.src: 8  The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

en: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
u.src: 8  The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

p.src: 9  The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

en: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
u.src: 9  The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

p.src: 10  All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.

en: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.
u.src: 10  All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.

p.src: 11  They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

en: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
u.src: 11  They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

p.src: 12  to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

en: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
u.src: 12  to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

p.src: 13  Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

en: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
u.src: 13  Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

en: 145:13 Some manuscripts omit these last two lines.

p.src: 14  The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

en: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
u.src: 14  The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

p.src: 15  The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

en: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
u.src: 15  The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

p.src: 16  You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

en: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
u.src: 16  You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

p.src: 17  The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

en: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
u.src: 17  The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

p.src: 18  The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

en: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
u.src: 18  The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

p.src: 19  He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

en: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
u.src: 19  He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

p.src: 20  The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

en: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
u.src: 20  The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

p.src: 21  My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

en: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
u.src: 21  My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
